name: Magnifier focus reveal
what: A statement sits pixelated on a dark red ground; a hand holding a round magnifier slides in from the right and sweeps along the text in short bobbing strokes, and inside the lens the words are sharp and clear while the rest stays a blur of pixels; at the end the hand drops out of the bottom of the frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f5-f21 the hand and lens slide in from the right edge, slowing; f21-f131 the lens sweeps left along the text in bobbing strokes (f21-f40 up, f40-f60 down, f60-f81 up, f81-f93 down, f93-f111 up, f111-f131 left to the far end) with the hand tilting a little each stroke; inside the lens the text is sharp, outside it is a mosaic; f131-f138 it lifts; f138-f146 it drops out of the bottom of the frame with a motion blur; the pixelated text is left to the end

tracks.name: lens in
tracks.what: the hand and magnifier slide in from the right edge

tracks.name: sweep
tracks.what: the lens sweeps left along the text in bobbing strokes, the hand swaying; the text is sharp inside the lens

tracks.name: lift and drop
tracks.what: the lens lifts at the far end, then drops out of the bottom of the frame, blurred

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the pixelated statement, still (the film grain moves)
